title: Iron Golem blacklists
description: Blacklists Iron Golems into attacking villagers(when they set off fireworks and hit the golems), players(friendly fire), other golems, and guards from guard villagers
body:
Blacklists Iron Golems into attacking villagers(when they set off fireworks and hit the golems), players(friendly fire), other golems, and guards from guard villagers         

Configurable in files to add or remove mobs
